scope: Opted-in raw capture of a versionless MATERIAL with a bounded common prefix and final group 94; no version-dependent meaning is assigned to that group.
checks: PASS: focused sparse-material tests in ASCII and binary. Disabled or missing policy refuses before callbacks; enabled capture retains unknown version, raw code and value without setting typed channel flags.
PASS: typed output refuses and preserves the destination; a malformed extra field refuses before callbacks, and corrected retry succeeds.
PASS: the same focused test under AddressSanitizer with leak detection disabled.
limits: Capture is not semantic qualification or authorization to replay a versionless record; callers must honor the raw-only marker and establish provenance before output.
The LibreCAD consumer integration and final-head platform checks are separate gates.
